subject.title: fix(config): fall back to provider-level contextWindow/maxTokens in model defaults

question: Should the canonical fix activate only provider-level `contextWindow` and `maxTokens`, or also activate the documented provider-level `contextTokens` default in the same release?
rationale: Both this PR and https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/105807 target the same owner boundary, but they intentionally differ on whether `contextTokens` is included; choosing the permanent config contract and canonical branch requires maintainer intent.

options.title: Extend this branch to all three fields
options.body: Keep this branch's stronger invalid-value and Mistral coverage, add provider-level `contextTokens` materialization and focused precedence tests, then close the competing PR.

options.title: Adopt the broader competing PR
options.body: Refresh https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/105807 and require equivalent invalid-provider and Mistral-normalization coverage before selecting it as canonical.

options.title: Keep the narrow two-field contract
options.body: Land this branch unchanged only after explicitly deciding that provider-level `contextTokens` should not materialize here and aligning the public documentation accordingly.

recommendation.title: Extend this branch to all three fields
recommendation.body: Keep this branch's stronger invalid-value and Mistral coverage, add provider-level `contextTokens` materialization and focused precedence tests, then close the competing PR.

likelyOwner.reason: Their history covers both the static default-materialization boundary and the discovered-model provider-context precedent.
